name: Usain Bolt
bio: Usain St. Leo Bolt is a retired Jamaican sprinter widely regarded as the greatest sprinter of all time. He is an eight-time Olympic gold medallist and the world record holder in the 100 metres (9.58 seconds), 200 metres (19.19 seconds), and 4 × 100 metres relay. Bolt achieved unprecedented global dominance by sweeping Olympic sprint doubles across three consecutive Olympic Games (Beijing 2008, London 2012, Rio 2016).

famousWorks.title: Unbroken World Record 100m (9.58s) and 200m (19.19s) in Berlin
Historic Triple-Gold Olympic Defense in London
Completing the Olympic 'Triple-Triple' Sprint Sweep in Rio

awards: 4 Laureus World Sportsman of the Year Awards (2009, 2010, 2013, 2017)

faq.q: What is Usain Bolt's 100-meter world record time?
faq.a: He ran the 100m in 9.58 seconds at the 2009 World Athletics Championships in Berlin, reaching a top speed of 44.72 km/h (27.78 mph).

faq.q: What is Usain Bolt's signature victory pose?
faq.a: His iconic 'Lightning Bolt' or 'To Di World' pose, where he leans back with one arm bent and the other pointing diagonally toward the sky.

name: Michael Phelps
bio: Michael Fred Phelps II is an American former competitive swimmer and the most successful and most decorated Olympian of all time, with a total of 28 medals. He holds the all-time records for Olympic gold medals (23), Olympic gold medals in individual events (13), and Olympic medals in individual events (16). At the 2008 Beijing Games, Phelps won a historic eight gold medals, breaking Mark Spitz's 1972 record.

famousWorks.title: Won 6 Gold Medals at Athens Summer Olympics
Record 8 Gold Medals in a Single Olympic Games (Beijing 2008)
Became the most decorated Olympian in history at London 2012
Won 5 Gold Medals at Rio 2016 concluding his legendary Olympic career

awards: World Swimmer of the Year (8 times)

faq.q: How many total Olympic medals did Michael Phelps win?
faq.a: Phelps won 28 Olympic medals: 23 gold, 3 silver, and 2 bronze across five Olympic Games (2000–2016).

faq.q: What record did Michael Phelps break at the 2008 Beijing Olympics?
faq.a: He won eight gold medals in a single Games, breaking Mark Spitz's 1972 record of seven golds.
